architectures.coral: Shared Linear(512,1) score without bias; two learned thresholds b and b+softplus(gap), cumulative probabilities P(y>0),P(y>1)

class_weights: Inverse square root of assessed fold-training class counts, normalized to mean 1; per-example weight for CORAL averaged binary loss
cv_population: Original TRAIN studies only; StratifiedGroupKFold over complete labeled targets, grouped by study_id. Both levels and unassessed targets remain assigned to the same fold as their study.
cv_epoch_selection: Strictly highest held-fold macro-F1 over labels [0,1,2], earliest epoch on ties; patience 5. This is development selection, not an unbiased nested-CV estimate.
final_fit_epochs: For each candidate and seed, median selected epoch across its three CV folds; refit on all original TRAIN for exactly that many epochs, then evaluate original validation once.
ensemble: Equal arithmetic mean of three seed probability vectors; no fitted weights, no test selection
candidate_selection: Highest arithmetic mean of the three CV-fold ensemble macro-F1 values; ties keep candidate order linear,mlp,coral
primary_metric: Macro-F1 on assessed targets with fixed labels [0,1,2]
other_metrics: severe detection among all requested severe targets

bootstrap.unit: study_id; both levels and failures resampled together
bootstrap.interval: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles; paired differences use identical sampled studies
bootstrap.scope: Fixed v1 test models and v2 development validation; no model or threshold selection from bootstrap test results

error_review.population: Train/validation only; purposive error sample, not a representative estimate
error_review.expert_review: Pending; do not change reference labels automatically

test_policy: Do not train, choose epochs/candidates, fit ensemble weights or tune thresholds using the already opened v1 test. Report new-version development results separately. Independent confirmation needs a new prospectively held-out cohort.
